title: Source Map
description: Complete outline of every input document. Stage 0 output. Stage 2 plans modules against it; Stage 5 audits that every 'procedure' section landed in a module or in training_brief.out_of_scope.

document_id.description: Stable short handle used in section/asset anchors, e.g. 'fsd'

sections.description: Every heading-delimited section in document order, flattened. section_id is the anchor Stage 1-3 cite and Stage 5 audits coverage against.

section_path.description: Full heading breadcrumb, e.g. '4. Purchase Orders > 4.2 Approval > 4.2.1 Thresholds'

clause_number.description: The document's own numbering if present, e.g. '4.2.1'

text.description: Full extracted body text of this section (not its subsections). What index_chunks.py chunks.

classifier.description: 'procedure' sections are what the coverage check enforces — every one must land in a module or training_brief.out_of_scope.
